mapper.select: SELECT id, incident_id, alert_event_id, create_time FROM sre_incident_alert_relation WHERE alert_event_id = #{alertEventId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sre_incident_alert_relation rel INNER JOIN sre_alert_event alert_row ON alert_row.id = rel.alert_event_id WHERE rel.incident_id = #{incidentId} AND alert_row.status = 'FIRING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sre_incident_alert_relation (incident_id, alert_event_id, create_time) VALUES (#{incidentId}, #{alertEventId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
